head: BountyBoard — Project management with on-chain bounties Bounty Board How it works Features On-chain Sign in Get started Project management, settled on Solana Ship the work. Earn the bounty. BountyBoard turns your roadmap into a marketplace. Post tasks with USDC bounties, collaborate in a kanban built for distributed teams, and pay contributors instantly on-chain when work is approved. Get started Learn more No credit card Free to start Solana wallet ready How it works From task to payout in three steps No spreadsheets, no Discord DMs about who got paid what. The whole loop lives in one place. 01 Create a project & post tasks Spin up a project, invite teammates, and break the work into tasks. Attach a USDC bounty to anything you want done. 02 Contributors claim & ship Members claim open tasks, work in the open, and submit a deliverable URL when they're ready for review. 03 Approve & pay on Solana Managers review the submission and release the bounty straight to the contributor's wallet — no invoices, no delays.
